searchText: i wish swag.ethereum.org was up again ): anyone from the EF know when it will come back? i would really like to buy a t-shirt and support the official EF what is that? I've been getting emails from them proof of personhood through retina scanning. proprietary hardware, software, saw a lot of hype and investment announcement ~6 months ago. uses cool tech like zk to break link between retina data and the assigned address. uses their own version of hubble as an L2 to scale general reaction: cool tech but suspicious on the dystopic vibes I mean, the reason I got curious is that it certainly has credentialed folks working on it. Also, I feel like the word hype and the blockchain sphere have so little to do with each other nowdays 😄 we're in the long crunch phase... credentialed people work on good and bad projects alike. judge for yourself 🙂 I mean there are different levels of credentialed... I'd consider myself credentialed but next to the folks behind worldcoin I scrub sewers on an outback planet 😄 I'm just kidding of course... I'd assume and hope that projects like that are receptive to criticism and feedback. they have been pretty open on twitter when the announcement first dropped
